description: The approval tool for the tasked slide's file (studio sessions only): read, write, test and web-fetch ONLY the tasked slide (the one with a live turn). Actions: list (every slide with state, no page needed), read (stored code of the tasked slide, empty when blank — other slides via studio_read), deliver (COMPLETE React code for the tasked slide: writes pages/PageNN.jsx, auto-tests it, auto-saves leftover hotlinked web images/fonts into the studio assets, hot-reloads), patch (old = one exact current block occurring exactly once, new = its replacement: edits in place, auto-tests, auto-saves web files, hot-reloads), test (trial-build check of the tasked slide: stored code, or the given code without writing), fetch (save ONE image/font into the studio assets now — file = working-folder file from image_search, or url = web image/font — plus your search words as query — returns the asset src path to use verbatim in code). Every write is trial-build tested automatically and the result (success or the exact error) returns as output. Never paste page code in chat text.

action.description: list | read | deliver | patch | test | fetch

code.description: Full React component for deliver (one component, export default), or candidate code for test (no write)

old.description: Exact current block for patch (must occur exactly once)

page_no.description: Tasked slide number (integer, 1-based). Not needed for list.

query.description: Search words for fetch (remembered as the asset description)

file.description: Working-folder file path for fetch (an image_search result, e.g. images/cat_1.jpg; copied into assets, wins over url)

url.description: Web image/font URL for fetch (http(s) only; ignored when file is given)

name: studio_page
title: Studio page tool
